name: Veronica's Closet
description: Veronica 'Ronnie' Chase is the 'Queen of Romance.' Founder of a successful lingerie empire, and best-selling author of self-help romance books, Ronnie has it all ... money, success, sex appeal and a philandering husband. How she will find true happiness without jeopardizing her business will be her biggest challenge yet.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Ronnie must decide whether to leave her husband or stay with him "for the sake of the business."

videos.title: Veronica's Woman Friend
videos.overview: Ronnie and Olive try to be friends outside the office; Josh is horrified when everyone starts using Perry's made-up word.

videos.title: Veronica's Husband Won't Leave
videos.overview: Ronnie is livid after Bryce pleads for her forgiveness on "Entertainment Tonight."

videos.title: Veronica's Not Happy About the Book
videos.overview: Divorce proceedings take an ugly turn when Bryce threatens to write a tell-all book about Ronnie.

videos.title: Veronica's First Date
videos.overview: Josh is infatuated with a rodeo cowboy who's more interested in roping Ronnie.

videos.title: Veronica's Best Buddy
videos.overview: Ronnie and Bryce battle for custody of their geriatric dog, Buddy. Perry dates a pregnant model.

videos.title: Veronica's a Doll
videos.overview: A toy company approaches Ronnie about making a Veronica Chase doll for its line of "female role models."

videos.title: Veronica's First Thanksgiving
videos.overview: Ronnie's plans for a "traditional" dinner are interrupted when Bryce's grandmother arrives.

videos.title: Veronica's Brotherly Love
videos.overview: Ronnie persuades Olive to set her up with her gorgeous brother, but discovers after one date that he's an egotist.

videos.title: Veronica's Christmas Song
videos.overview: Olive sings a solo at the Lincoln Center Christmas show while Ronnie is given a less glamorous role. Bryce has ulterior motives for asking Josh to dinner.

videos.title: Veronica's Got a Secret
videos.overview: Olive's boyfriend makes at pass at Ronnie. Kathy Najimy.

videos.title: Veronica's Fun and Pirates are Crazy
videos.overview: Bryce decides he wants to "work" at the office, but his antics only disrupt things for Ronnie, and cause her to wonder if the staff likes him more than her.

videos.title: Veronica's Night Alone
videos.overview: Ronnie stirs up controversy, and jeopardizes a date with Kevin Costner, after writing about the joys of "romancing yourself." Leo learns about Tina's past romances.

videos.title: Veronica's $600,000 Pop
videos.overview: A glitch in her divorce proceedings stymies Ronnie's plans to consummate her renewed relationship with an old flame. Perry deals with his girlfriend's superstitions.

videos.title: Veronica's a Drag
videos.overview: Ronnie copes with a kleptomaniac-supermodel and sues a drag queen who's been mocking her on TV.

videos.title: Veronica's Divorce Papers
videos.overview: Olive and the staff don't trust Bryce when he asks Ronnie to be his friend once their divorce is final. Christopher McDonald.

videos.title: Veronica's Blackout
videos.overview: Ronnie celebrates her divorce with a trip to Atlantic City---only to return with a new husband.

videos.title: Veronica's Bridal Shower
videos.overview: Olive feels stripped of her pride when asked what her new man does for a living; Perry tries to bond with his new girlfriend's son.

videos.title: Veronica's Man in a Suitcase
videos.overview: Ronnie returns from the airport with a suitcase that she concludes belongs to the perfect man. Tina scores more than an autograph when she meets football star Keyshawn Johnson.

videos.title: Veronica's All-Nighter
videos.overview: Leo learns his fiancée kissed another man. The staff scrambles to produce a summer catalogue.

videos.title: Veronica's Mole
videos.overview: In an effort to expand the company, Ronnie seeks the help of a silent partner.

videos.title: Veronica's Silent Partner
videos.overview: Ronnie's partner takes a liking to Josh, who responds in shocking fashion.

videos.title: Veronica Gets Her Closet Back
videos.overview: Hunter's stepfather arrives to check up on him---and he winds up charming the former boss, Ronnie.

videos.title: Veronica's a Partner Now
videos.overview: Anger and sexual tension rise between Ronnie and Alec as they try to share an office and run the company together.

videos.title: Veronica's Great Model Search
videos.overview: Ronnie searches for a fresh face to feature as the catalogue's cover girl; Josh ends up on the outs with an altar-bound chum.

videos.title: Veronica's Dog Day Afternoon
videos.overview: Olive and Perry share an awkward moment. Alec acts like a scared kitten around Ronnie's dog.

videos.title: Veronica's Crushed
videos.overview: Ronnie finds Alec's chivalry attractive. Leo wants to be Perry's roommate.

videos.title: Veronica's on the Herb
videos.overview: Olive and Ronnie grow disillusioned with the effects of a health herb, while Alec plots revenge against his ex after Perry starts dating her.

videos.title: Veronica's Breast Effort
videos.overview: A woman sues the company over a defect caused by a sports bra; Olive gets down to business with the new intern.

videos.title: Veronica's Thanksgiving that Keeps on Giving
videos.overview: Thanksgiving dinner is a family affair for Olive, who sets a place for her young beau and his attractive dad.

videos.title: Veronica's Cheating Partners
videos.overview: Ronnie acts like a woman scorned when Alec entertains offers from another company. Leo and his girlfriend play a name game.

videos.title: Veronica's Secret Santa
videos.overview: Ronnie gets naughty with a nice department-store Santa, then cries out when she sees who's under the beard.

videos.title: Veronica's From Venus; Josh's Parents are From Mars
videos.overview: Josh receives a birthday visit from his boisterous parents. Leo and Perry find what they think is a dream apartment.

videos.title: Veronica's Desk Job
videos.overview: After a tiff with Alec, Josh quits his job as executive assistant and goes to work for Perry.

videos.title: Veronica's Wedding Bell Blues
videos.overview: Ronnie is horrified when her ex-husband, Bryce, invites her to his wedding.

videos.title: Veronica Plays House
videos.overview: Ronnie persuades Alec that it's time to buy a townhouse---and that she should be his decorator; Josh has a girlfriend.

videos.title: Veronica's Favorite Year
videos.overview: An eccentric photographer (John Ritter) has trouble focusing on the project Ronnie hires him to shoot, leaving Alec furious.

videos.title: Veronica's Little Tribute
videos.overview: Ronnie plans to present a `humorous' tribute during a dinner honoring Alec.

videos.title: Veronica Falls Hard
videos.overview: An encounter with Alec takes Ronnie off her feet---literally; Josh meets Chloe's Irish family on St. Patrick's Day.

videos.title: Veronica's Big Date
videos.overview: Josh gains a wealth of knowledge about his girlfriend, while Ronnie and Alec try to keep their affair under wraps.

videos.title: Veronica's Big Homecoming
videos.overview: The staff heads for Kansas when they learn Ronnie's home town plans to name a street "Veronica Chase Boulevard."

videos.title: Veronica's Little Ruse
videos.overview: Ronnie's charity-ball date sparks jealousy in Alec, who thinks their relationship should go back to business---and only business.

videos.title: Veronica's Night at the Theater
videos.overview: Alec offers Justin half of the company, because Justin has "won" Ronnie. Olive spots an ex in the cast of "Cabaret."

videos.title: Veronica Says Goodbye
videos.overview: Ronnie agrees to a weekend away with Justin, and Alec abruptly announces that he's leaving the company.

videos.title: Veronica's New Boss
videos.overview: Ronnie reels at the news that Alec has died in a bizarre volcano accident, but she really blows her top when she comes face-to-face with his widow. Meanwhile, Josh has a surprise for the rest of the office.

videos.title: Veronica's June Swoon
videos.overview: Already sick of Alec's widow, June, Ronnie schemes to get rid of her new boss by malevolent means, but her staff's lack of cooperation inhibits her departure. Also: Josh's efforts to be one of the guys on a golf outing with Chloe's father are way out-of-bounds.

videos.title: Veronica's Construction Worker
videos.overview: Ronnie is temporarily distracted from the office remodelling by a fling with the construction foreman. Also: Perry becomes the butt of a cruel joke when the men's room is out of order; and Olive gets a new perspective when she reads to a blind teenager.

videos.title: Veronica's Office: Bigger, Longer and Cuter
videos.overview: The office renovation is complete, and Ronnie thinks June is trying to trick her into choosing inferior accommodations. Also, a videotape from Leo's past comes back to haunt him.

videos.title: Veronica's New Cat
videos.overview: Ronnie turns especially catty when her birthday gift to Olive is not nearly as purr-fect as Josh's. Meanwhile, Perry and Leo go to extremes to see a different side of June.

videos.title: Veronica's Long Walk Home
videos.overview: Taking a page from the Rosie Ruiz training manual, Ronnie learns a long, hard lesson about shortcuts at a charity walkathon. Meanwhile, Josh and Chloe perform a dress rehearsal of their upcoming marriage.

videos.title: Veronica's Got All the Right Stuffing
videos.overview: Ronnie's Thanksgiving bash becomes just that when she and June try to beat the stuffing out of one another. Josh cooks for Chloe's brothers. Perry gets a monkey off his back at the holiday parade.

videos.title: Veronica's Sliding Doors
videos.overview: A trip to Miami for Ronnie and her staff plays out in different scenarios, depending on which flight they board. Tara Lipinski and Pete Rose appear as themselves.

videos.title: Veronica's New Year
videos.overview: Ronnie nearly loses her head getting ready for a New Year's Eve duet with Isaac Hayes. Leo puts his feelings for Lana in writing. Perry tries to catch up on some last-minute resolutions.

videos.title: Veronica's Perfect Man
videos.overview: Ronnie “smells” trouble with a sexy new suitor. Olive learns good things don't always come in small packages.

videos.title: Veronica's Record
videos.overview: Veronica vies to set an unusual world record; Josh shrinks from confrontation with a hostile neighbor. Perry's senile grandfather grows alarmingly fond of Leo.

videos.title: Veronica's Tattooed Man
videos.overview: When Ronnie dates Olive's former beau, she is tormented by a constant reminder of their relationship. Josh defends Perry and Leo from the office bully.

videos.title: Veronica's Candy Panties
videos.overview: Stressed out about planning his wedding, Josh goes on an eating binge. Ronnie causes a Valentine's Day marketing massacre.

videos.title: Veronica's New Bookshelves
videos.overview: Josh and Chloe both develop crushes on their wedding planner. Ronnie enjoys a steamy reunion with June's hunky father.

videos.title: Veronica's Sleepover
videos.overview: Ronnie nervously anticipates an overnight stay with Tom. Leo aspires to be the best man at Josh's wedding.

videos.title: Veronica's Girls' Night Out
videos.overview: At Josh's bachelor party, his longstanding flirtation with best pal Brian goes a step further.

videos.title: Veronica Helps Josh Out
videos.overview: On the eve of his wedding to Chloe, Josh finally confronts the issue of his latent homosexuality. Perry plots to seduce June.

videos.title: Veronica Sets Josh Up
videos.overview: As Josh faces his first official day out of the closet, Ronnie and Olive compete to find him a new beau.

videos.title: Veronica Loses Her Olive Again
videos.overview: Ronnie begs Olive to come back to Veronica's Closet; Leo accidentally telephones a supermodel.

videos.title: Veronica's Doing the Nasty With Perry
videos.overview: The latest office romance is a surprise; Leo tries to teach Josh how to play basketball.

videos.title: Veronica Checks Out
videos.overview: Ronnie and Perry encounter trouble in their new romance.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 9 wins & 11 nominations total
